name: video_transcript
description: Get what is said in an online video (YouTube and other yt-dlp sites) from its subtitles or automatic captions, without downloading the video. Use it to summarise, quote, translate or search a video. Formats: text (clean paragraphs, the best for reading), timestamped ([m:ss] every ~20 seconds, best for citing moments) or srt. Rolling duplicates in automatic captions are removed. Long transcripts are saved to a file in the workspace and the beginning is returned.

url.description: Address of the video page (http or https).

language.description: Caption language code, such as en, hi, es or pt-BR. Default en.

format.description: text, timestamped or srt. Default text.

save_to.description: Also save the transcript to this file, relative to the workspace.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return; longer transcripts are saved to a file. Default 40000.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
